title: Changing the Shipping Address or Delivery Service of an Online Orders Order
content:
The shipping address or the delivery service of an Online Orders order can be changed only while the order is in status placed; after release the agent cannot redirect a parcel. The order's status as shown on that order's record decides whether the change is possible.

The new address must be served by the order's service, or the new service must serve the address, under the placement rules. The effective shipping fee, the surcharge and the delivery promise are recomputed under the shipping-fee rules as of the change date; a higher fee is collected at dispatch, a lower one simply replaces it. A new street line is recorded verbatim as the customer gives it, with the new state and ZIP.

## Judgement by order status

| Order status | Address change | Service change |
|---|---|---|
| Placed | Possible | Possible |
| Processing | Not possible; the parcel cannot be redirected | Not possible |
| Shipped, delivered, closed or cancelled | Not possible | Not possible |

## What a change recomputes

| Change | Must hold | Recomputed as of the change date |
|---|---|---|
| New shipping address | The order's current service serves the new address under the placement rules | Effective shipping fee, surcharge and delivery promise |
| New delivery service | The new service serves the order's address under the placement rules | Effective shipping fee, surcharge and delivery promise |

## Fee outcomes (hypothetical figures)

- The order was placed with an effective shipping fee of 0.00, and the customer switches to a service whose effective fee, recomputed as of the change date, is 7.00. The fee becomes 7.00 and the higher amount is collected at dispatch.
- The order was placed with an effective shipping fee of 7.00, and the recomputed fee on the new service is 0.00. The lower fee simply replaces the earlier one.
